origin.description: Creates a Formula object from a formula which can have the | operator on the left- and/or right-hand side. It stores the original formula along with lhs and rhs attributes containing the decomposed parts.
origin.example: Formula on a two-part regressor formula and a multi-response multi-part formula, then class, length, and lhs/rhs attributes
